meta_description: Ryan Holden Electrical provides domestic and commercial electrical work across Leeds. NICEIC registered, same-day repairs, and 24/7 emergency callouts available.
hero_subhead: Faulty electrics, blown fuses, or rewiring work? We diagnose faults fast and fix them right, often the same day.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs and fault finding to full rewires and new installations, we handle domestic and commercial work to the highest standard.

services.title: Emergency Callouts & Repairs
services.desc: Lights out, tripped electrics, or dangerous faults? We arrive quickly and fix most problems on the spot. Available nights and weekends.

services.title: Fault Finding & Diagnostics
services.desc: Intermittent electrical issues or blown circuits? We trace the root cause using proper testing equipment and explain what needs fixing.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring causing problems? We replace the lot to modern standards, often in 3–5 days, with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: New Installations & Upgrades
services.desc: Installing EV chargers, new circuits, or consumer units? We design and fit safe, compliant systems that meet Building Regulations.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Work
services.desc: Shops, offices, and workshops need reliable electrics. We undertake maintenance, repairs, and new installations with minimal downtime.

services.title: Periodic Testing & Certification
services.desc: Landlords and businesses need proof your electrics are safe. We test your installation and provide full compliance certificates.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I wanted to do the job properly and charge fairly.
about_para_1: Ryan Holden Electrical was founded on a simple principle: show up on time, do the work right first time, and be honest about what you need. For over 15 years we've built a reputation across Leeds for reliable, no-nonsense electrical work. We're NICEIC registered and continuously trained, so you can trust that your electrics are in safe hands.
about_para_2: Most of our work comes from repeat customers and referrals — that's how we know we're doing something right. Whether you need an emergency repair at midnight or a full rewire planned months ahead, we treat your home with the same respect we'd treat our own. We don't use apprentices unsupervised, we don't overcharge, and we explain what we're doing every step of the way.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a complete rewire done last month. Ryan was professional, tidy, and finished on schedule. He explained everything clearly and the quality of the work is outstanding. Really can't fault him. Will definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Our kitchen electrics packed in on a Sunday evening. Called Ryan as a last resort and he was here within the hour. Turned out to be a faulty circuit breaker. He fixed it, wouldn't charge an extra call-out fee, and even showed me how to reset it safely. Legend.
reviews.author: Patricia K.

reviews.text: Had Ryan install two EV chargers at our office. Very knowledgeable, minimal fuss, and the whole job was done in a day. Got the certificate we needed for the insurance. Proper job.
reviews.author: James T.
